strategy: Run baseline until enclosure target or mesh cap; only if target remains unmet at cap, run split-2 from 16 to same cap.
timing: perf_counter around certify calls only; includes both paths when fallback called; one randomized run per setup, no warmups; excludes setup/startup/I-O/reference
scope: post-hoc online feasibility on 24 existing and previously studied polynomial PINNs; not a new blind test or general performance benchmark
